name: What do I need to prepare before plumbing trade coordination begins?

mainEntity.name: What do I need to prepare before plumbing trade coordination begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling plumbing rough-in work, you should have fixture specifications, product cut sheets, and layout choices finalized. Plumbers require exact manufacturer dimensions for rough-in valves, freestanding tub drains, wall-mounted faucets, and shower systems before setting pipes behind walls. During consultation with HH Remodeling LLC, we review your selected fixtures alongside our finish carpentry and tile plans. Having technical sheets ready avoids tear-out later, ensures shower valves are recessed to the correct depth for your specific tile thickness, and prevents delays during rough-in execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide detailed manufacturer specification sheets for all sinks, faucets, valves, and tubs so rough-ins match exact tile and depth requirements.
